description: This PHP script serves as an entry point for redirecting to an external OAuth provider within the SuiteCRM project. It validates the request, initializes an OAuth authorization service, and initiates the OAuth flow by redirecting the client.

classes.name: OAuthAuthorizationService
classes.description: A service class managing OAuth authorization interactions, such as provider validation and redirect handling.

methods.name: hasProvider
methods.description: Checks if a given OAuth provider is supported and properly configured.

methods.name: cleanSession
methods.description: Clears any existing OAuth session data.

methods.name: authorizationRedirect
methods.description: Handles redirecting the user-agent to the OAuth provider's authorization endpoint.
